summaries.Romania: Romania faces mounting political and economic pressures with PSD-AUR blocking fiscal transparency while security services expose Russian sabotage networks coordinating attacks on critical infrastructure. Budget deficits, administrative reform pushback, and hybrid threats dominate governance amid coalition tensions.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focuses on AI-driven clinical tools and drug development breakthroughs, while policy debates center on Epic's market dominance stifling competition and prior authorization delays impacting patient access.
